opportunities.title: Reduce unused CSS

opportunities.title: Reduce unused JavaScript

opportunities.title: Properly size images
opportunities.description: Serve images that are appropriately-sized to save cellular data and improve load time. [Learn how to size images](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/uses-responsive-images/).

opportunities.title: Minify JavaScript
opportunities.description: Minifying JavaScript files can reduce payload sizes and script parse time. [Learn how to minify JavaScript](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unminified-javascript/).

opportunities.title: Avoid serving legacy JavaScript to modern browsers
opportunities.description: Polyfills and transforms enable legacy browsers to use new JavaScript features. However, many aren't necessary for modern browsers. Consider modifying your JavaScript build process to not transpile [Baseline](https://web.dev/baseline) features, unless you know you must support legacy browsers. diagnostics.title: Serves images with low resolution

diagnostics.title: Minimize main-thread work

diagnostics.title: Reduce JavaScript execution time
